name: Batman: Arkham City Lockdown Vita
author: KiddRwxSsj
description: Batman: Arkham City Lockdown is a mobile fighting game developed by NetherRealm Studios and published by WB Games. The player controls Batman fighting through Arkham City against inmates and villains in one-on-one encounters, using strikes, counters and swipe-based combos, with upgradeable abilities and unlockable batsuits. This is a port of the Android version (1.0.2) to PS Vita, running the game's original code natively through a so-loader. It adds physical button mapping, tilt steering for the batarang, a built-in viewer for the Extras comic and batsuits purchasable with in-game WayneTech points instead of real money. Online features are not available.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
